body:
Resolve GitHub Issue #21: centralize all model slugs, aliases, tier candidates, prosecutors, and role model constants into `lib/models.mjs`.

Tasks:
1. Create `lib/models.mjs` as the single source of truth exporting:
   - `MODELS` (moved verbatim from `lib/agy.mjs:90-105`)
   - `ALL_MODELS = Object.freeze(Object.values(MODELS).flat())`
   - `MODEL_ALIASES` and `RETIRED_35_MAP` (moved verbatim from `lib/agy.mjs:107-137`)
   - `TIER_CANDIDATES` (`cheap`, `mid`, `frontier`, moved verbatim from `lib/pools.mjs:80-100`)
   - `PROSECUTORS` (`{ gemini: 'gpt-oss-120b-medium', claude: 'gemini-3.1-pro-high', 'gpt-oss': 'gemini-3.1-pro-high' }`, moved from `lib/pools.mjs:104-108`)
   - `PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`: `{ gemini: ['gpt-oss-120b-medium', 'claude-sonnet-4-6'], claude: ['gemini-3.1-pro-high', 'gemini-3.8-flash-high', 'gpt-oss-120b-medium'], 'gpt-oss': ['gemini-3.1-pro-high', 'gemini-3.8-flash-high', 'claude-sonnet-4-6'] }`
   - `ROLE_MODELS`: `{ coldstart: 'gemini-3.8-flash-low', premortem: 'gemini-3.1-pro-high', parallaxReader: 'gemini-3.8-flash-medium', parallaxJudge: 'gemini-3.1-pro-high', brainConvert: 'gemini-3.1-pro-high', probeDefault: 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low)', reviewFleetAlternates: ['gemini-3.8-flash-high', 'gemini-3.1-pro-high'] }`
   - `modelFor(role)` helper returning `ROLE_MODELS[role]` (throwing `new Error('Unknown model role: ' + role)` if undefined)
   - Helper functions moved from `lib/agy.mjs` and `lib/pools.mjs`: `resolveModelSlug(model)`, `poolOf(model)`, `familyOf(model)`, `upstreamPoolOf(model)` (where `const pool = poolOf(model); return pool.startsWith('gemini') ? 'gemini' : 'claude_gpt';`), and `tierCandidates(tier, poolHint)`.
2. Re-export `MODELS`, `ALL_MODELS`, `MODEL_ALIASES`, `resolveModelSlug`, `poolOf`, `familyOf`, `upstreamPoolOf` from `lib/agy.mjs` and `TIER_CANDIDATES`, `PROSECUTORS`, `PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`, `tierCandidates`, `poolOf`, `upstreamPoolOf` from `lib/pools.mjs` so all existing external/test imports remain 100% backward-compatible. Update `prosecutorsFor(builderModel)` in `lib/pools.mjs:1803-1815` to read from `PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES[fam]` and fallback `[PROSECUTORS[fam] || PROSECUTORS.claude]` so no raw model strings remain in `lib/pools.mjs`.
3. Replace hardcoded model string literals in:
   - `lib/plan.mjs` (`PREMORTEM_MODEL = ROLE_MODELS.premortem`, `PARALLAX_READER_MODEL = ROLE_MODELS.parallaxReader`, `PARALLAX_JUDGE_MODEL = ROLE_MODELS.parallaxJudge`)
   - `lib/preflight.mjs` (`COLDSTART_MODEL = ROLE_MODELS.coldstart`)
   - `lib/brain.mjs` (default `model = ROLE_MODELS.brainConvert` in `brainToPlan` at line 142)
   - `bin/agb.mjs` (default probe model `ROLE_MODELS.probeDefault` at line 321)
   - `lib/review.mjs` (default alternating lens models `ROLE_MODELS.reviewFleetAlternates[i % ROLE_MODELS.reviewFleetAlternates.length]` at line 116)
4. Add `test/models-registry.test.mjs` verifying:
   - Every model slug in `TIER_CANDIDATES`, `PROSECUTORS`, `PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`, `ROLE_MODELS` (via `resolveModelSlug` for strings or array elements), and `MODEL_ALIASES` values is a member of `ALL_MODELS`.
   - Scanning all `lib/*.mjs` files (excluding `lib/models.mjs` and stripping `//` and `/* */` comments) with regex `/['"](?:gemini-3\.[0-9][^'"]*|claude-(?:sonnet|opus)-[0-9][^'"]*|gpt-oss-[0-9][^'"]*)['"]/` finds 0 matches.
5. Run `npm run build` and `node website/scripts/check-all.mjs` so `dist/` bundles and docs checks are completely clean.
title: Centralize model-name registry into lib/models.mjs (#21)
